boundary: Ranges enclose observed development data only. Product-box overlap is failure of this conservative certificate; it is not a proof of physical nonidentifiability. No Gaussian, independence or universal noise claim.
rule: A physical sensor separates a pair of component severity envelopes if at least one of its19 fixed features has strictly disjoint empirical train+selection min-max intervals. All nuisance conditions in train+selection are included. Test features are excluded.
status: post-hoc supplementary diagnostic, not a new held-out experiment
